name: Read Time Meter
description: Answers the question you ask before every long article: how many minutes is this? Pick your reading speed and get an honest estimate, plus the word and character counts, sentence and paragraph totals, a readability score with its school grade, the words that repeat most and the sentence most likely to lose your reader. Works on a selection, a whole page or pasted text.

browser_action.default_title: Read Time Meter — How long is this really going to take?
